1.source_text: And now, concerning my servant Parley P. Pratt, behold, 1 say unto him, that as I live I will that he shall declare my Gospel, and learn of me, and be meek and lowly of heart; and that which I have appointed onto him is, that he shall go with my servants Oliver Cowdery, and Peter Whitmer, jun., into the wilderness, among the Lamanites; and Ziba Peterson, also, shall go with them, and 1 myself…
